Agent Name: Planner
, Step Number: 5
, Reason for Mistake: The Planner accepted a DuckDuckGo/Wikipedia snippet stating the Albanian Fascist Party held power until 1944 and incorrectly claimed Italy capitulated in 1944. They ignored conflicting evidence in the same results (Nevington War Museum noting 1943) and failed to verify by opening sources. The correct year is 1943, when Italy capitulated and the party’s power ended.
